node.label: Increased double-negative T cell number
node.definition: Abnormal increase of double negative (DN) CD3+CD4-CD8- T cells, measured as percentage of total CD3+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population.

evidence.snippet: Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome: Increased double-negative T cell number (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
